cards.title: TINKERER
cards.concept: friendly tinkerer in a grey work shirt and worn leather apron, holding a big wrench against his chest with a couple of brass gears tucked in the apron pocket.
cards.hook: Engineering background: he started out building and fixing things with his own hands.

cards.title: LEDGER KEEPER
cards.concept: cheerful ledger keeper in a plain waistcoat and rolled sleeves, a thick bound ledger hugged to his chest, a small wooden abacus beside it and a quill tucked behind his ear.
cards.hook: Former CFO of a non-profit: every coin counted, every column balanced.

cards.title: TAVERN DEALER
cards.concept: grinning tavern card dealer in a grey vest over a collared shirt, fanning a plain deck of playing cards in front of his chest.
cards.hook: Mastercard alumnus: the original master of the card table.

cards.title: MAP SKETCHER
cards.concept: village map sketcher in a simple linen tunic, a half-drawn parchment road map held up at chest height and a charcoal pencil behind his ear.
cards.hook: Product management: sketching the roadmap before anyone walks the road.

cards.title: INNKEEPER
cards.concept: welcoming innkeeper in a rolled-sleeve shirt and grey apron, raising a wooden tankard at chest height with a big warm grin.
cards.hook: His warm, approachable grin: the host everyone is glad to see.

cards.title: GEARWRIGHT
cards.concept: guild gearwright in a utility vest with green trim, brass goggles pushed up on his forehead, and a little clockwork sparrow with green glass eyes perched on his shoulder.
cards.hook: Engineering: the trained builder, now with a mechanical companion of his own making.

cards.title: QUEST GIVER
cards.concept: smiling quest giver in a green-lined traveller's coat, holding out a rolled scroll sealed with a green wax seal at chest height.
cards.hook: Product management: PMs write the quests (user stories) the whole party sets out on.

cards.title: COIN COURIER
cards.concept: swift coin courier in a green hooded cloak with a leather satchel strap across his chest, a sealed payment letter in hand and a carrier pigeon on his shoulder.
cards.hook: Mastercard: moving payments safely from one hand to another across the network.

cards.title: PARTY LEADER
cards.concept: adventuring party leader in practical leather armour with green accents, a green pennant banner rising over his shoulder behind his head, grinning with a rallying look.
cards.hook: Technical and administrative leadership: the approachable leader who keeps the party moving together.

cards.title: ARTIFICER
cards.concept: seasoned artificer in fitted leather and brass with teal inlays, a mechanical owl with faintly teal-glowing eyes perched on his shoulder, a small teal-lit gadget held at his chest.
cards.hook: Product builder: engineering turned into living, useful creations.

cards.title: CARD MAGE
cards.concept: card mage in a teal-trimmed long coat, fanning a hand of softly teal-glowing playing cards between his fingers in front of his chest.
cards.hook: Mastercard: here the cards are the magic.

cards.title: TREASURY PALADIN
cards.concept: treasury paladin in fitted silver plate with teal enamel trim, a round shield embossed with a glowing teal coin sigil raised beside his chest.
cards.hook: Non-profit CFO: sworn guardian of the funds that serve a good cause.

cards.title: GOLEM FORGER
cards.concept: master golem forger in an ornate dark forge-apron with violet rune stitching, glowing violet eyes, a hulking stone golem etched with violet runes looming behind his shoulders.
cards.hook: Builds products: engineering at a scale where the creation stands taller than its maker.

cards.title: SEER OF PATHS
cards.concept: arcane seer in ornate violet robes with a magenta-lined high collar, glowing eyes, a luminous violet roadmap of branching paths and milestone stars unfurling in the air behind his head.
cards.hook: Chief Product Officer: he sees every path the product can take before it is walked.

cards.title: WORLD ARCHITECT
cards.concept: ascended architect of worlds in gold and white regalia with a radiant crown of golden gears, cradling a glowing golden miniature planet at his chest while blueprint constellations and a golden halo blaze behind his head.
cards.hook: Chief Product Officer and engineer: the ultimate product builder, designing entire worlds from the blueprint up.
